sources.location: mqpar.xml inside https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2024/02/PXD047614/1.zip (HTTP range read of ZIP; 2/3/4.zip carry the same layout, only 1.zip read)

claims.evidence: sampleAttributes NEWT:9606 and BTO blood serum; title 'human serum proteins'

claims.location: characteristics[pulldown group], factor value[pulldown group] S1,S2 / S3,S4
claims.evidence: readme: 'Sample 1 and 2 are negative controls, while sample 3 and 4 are ISG75+ pulldowns'. Nature of the negative control not stated.
11 RAW files in PRIDE; S4 has only two. Treated as technical-replicate injections of one source each (protocol: 'Triplicates for each sample were combined').
sampleProcessingProtocol: Lys-C 1:100 2 h then trypsin 1:50 overnight
50 mM DTT 37C 1 h; 50 mM IAA 20 min dark

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable; Acetyl protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: mqpar.xml fixed/variable modification lists, matching dataProcessingProtocol
MaxQuant main-search tolerance and FTMS MS/MS tolerance (MS2 acquired in Orbitrap)
PRIDE instrument MS:1002416; RAW header method 'OTOT_HCD_105min', ActivationType=HCD, Detector Type=Orbitrap, MS2 resolution 15K
Inferred: top-speed style Orbitrap/Orbitrap HCD method with MaxQuant DDA search; not stated in prose

limitations: No publication; no per-sample demographics, so age, sex, ancestry category, individual and disease are 'not available'.
Identity of the negative control (e.g. bait-less beads vs control protein) is not stated.
The deposit's MaxQuant search lists Trypsin only; the Lys-C step comes from the protocol prose.
characteristics[pulldown group] is a non-template custom column.
2.zip, 3.zip, 4.zip mqpar.xml not read; 1.zip only (same MaxQuant version/settings assumed).
